_doc: V9 plan M3.2 -- ed25519 trust roots for golden manifest signatures. Active keys sign new manifests; revoked keys block any signature claim. Rotation: add a new active key (valid_from earlier than the existing key's planned expiry), overlap period for clients to fetch the new key, then move the old key to revoked_keys. Private keys live in $TAB_GPFS_ROOT/keys/<key_id>.priv (mode 0400 owner=$TAB_PROVIDER_USER).
